headline: Samsung's Galaxy SmartTag 3 adds iPhone support and pet tracking
summary: Samsung announced the Galaxy SmartTag 3, its third-generation Bluetooth tracker, with a smaller design, improved battery life, and cross-OS support that works with iPhones. Engadget highlights its use as a pet activity monitor, tracking location, motion and sleep.
